name: annual-reviews
description: Draft annual reviews and self-reviews from performance notes. Evidence ledgers, rubric mapping, bias audits. Helps you write it; never decides ratings or promotions.

interface.longDescription: Drafts manager reviews and self-reviews from performance notes, with an evidence ledger behind every strength and growth area, rubric mapping, and measurable development actions. The Review Audit checks period coverage, attribution, evidence quality, and biased language in an existing draft. Missing incidents, dates, metrics, or rubric terms are shown as gaps, never filled in. It does not recommend or fill in ratings and does not make layoff, promotion, compensation, or termination decisions; those stay with the people accountable for them. Built from the Annual Reviews playbook at andrewluxem.com. Static skill: no network calls.
capabilities: Manager review drafts with an evidence ledger
Self-review drafts from your own notes
Review audits for evidence gaps and biased language
defaultPrompt: Turn these performance notes into my self-review
Draft an annual review for my direct report
